title: Pre-registered analysis plan (hashed by `python -m experiments.preregister freeze`; implemented by experiments/aggregate.py)
scoring: Human labels are the only score. Labels are made on the model-blind sheet (experiments.label_sheet), which hides the model but not the case.

arms.headline_holm_family: the 4 arms, one test per arm and rule; at alpha .05/4 an arm needs at least 8 discordant pairs (agent right, rule wrong, none the other way)
arms.free_arm_contingency: if the free arm halts permanently (any cost above zero, a non-free served model, an unverifiable $0, a permanent unavailability, or availability failures on 3 distinct UTC days without a completed run), the benchmark continues with the 3 paid arms; the family becomes those 3 arms (at least 7 discordant pairs); the decision is recorded in <runs>/free_arm_halt.json and the free arm's completed runs are reported descriptively only
arms.user_rule: If Nemotron would be paid, don't execute it; use it only if free; otherwise keep 3 models.
arms.glm_cost_switch: if GLM's median cost per run in the pre-pilot is above $0.109, then before P2 either switch to the novita-fp8 pin ($0.63 / $1.98 per million; a new arm id) or record cost_switch.decision = 'accept' (GLM may stop early at its $3.40 cap); `batch --plan` reports which; the main phase refuses to start while it is undecided; z-ai fp8 stays the default

cases.rows: 38 per arm, 152 in total; the free arm has its own blocks and is interleaved only while its daily request budget allows

per_fault: every metric block is reported for hidden, visible, healthy, all, and for each fault separately

metrics.Q1: strict hidden accuracy (diagnosis_label = correct / human-valid hidden runs), Wilson 95%; localization (localized = yes) and detection (detected = yes); ITT: model-caused invalids (unparseable or token-limited conclusion) count as wrong
metrics.Q1_rules: R1, R0, R2 (recency) and R3 (cause-naming runbook that may abstain), each scored strictly and for localization on the same runs; exact McNemar per arm, Holm-adjusted over the headline family
metrics.Q2: healthy false-alarm rate pooled over the family with Wilson (per arm descriptive only); P(correct | confirmed); selective accuracy (accuracy on non-abstained fault runs) with coverage
metrics.Q3: cost per correct diagnosis; median cost per run; Fisher exact arm vs arm on hidden strict accuracy (descriptive except GLM vs the better cheap arm)
metrics.Q4: confidence-downgrade gate offline, reported both ways: precision of 'confirmed' self-reported vs enforced, wrong confirmations caught AND correct confirmations downgraded
metrics.Q5: pass^k for k = 1, 2, 4, unbiased C(c,k)/C(n,k) per (arm, case) cell, averaged over cells; modal consistency
metrics.Q6: Cohen's kappa, auto-labeller vs blind human labels (second rater only); share of runs passing the manipulation check

availability: free-arm availability failures (429, rate limit, transient provider error) are reported separately; they are not model failures and do not use up a re-queue

registered_comparisons.localization: latency_injected (go-server) vs latency_enricher (go-enricher): same mechanism, different component; per arm, Fisher exact, strict and localization
registered_comparisons.mechanism: latency_injected vs cpu_throttled: same component (go-server), different mechanism; per arm, Fisher exact, strict and localization

sensitivity: hidden faults without client_timeout_too_low (its cause is visible in a single read_config reply and its recreated container is visibly younger, rule R2)
hidden faults without runs whose manipulation check failed (no symptom in the model-free snapshot)
rule_r3: decision list on the model-free runbook snapshots using only signals the agent's tools can observe: (a) a Go service config setting that differs from the pre-injection snapshot names the service and the setting; (b) a p50 latency ratio or error ratio above threshold names the service; (c) then a CPU signal (GOMAXPROCS lower than before, or CPU rate above threshold) names cpu, a latency anomaly without one names network delay, errors alone name errors; otherwise abstain. Thresholds (r3_thresholds.json) come only from healthy-run data (margin 1.5 x the largest healthy value), never from fault labels or case names; derive them (`python -m experiments.runbook_rule derive`) and re-freeze before P2; until then they are flagged provisional
validity: a running-target fault whose container is not running after injection (go-server has no restart policy, so a failed startup ping leaves it exited) is invalid with the cause 'target not running after injection'; it is re-run once and never scored as the registered fault
not_claimed: rankings of arms whose intervals overlap
results from cases that failed the Phase 0 gate unless reported as such
